_comment: Every number a playtest is likely to move. `make run` recopies this file without rebuilding, so retuning never costs a compile. Anything added here needs a matching key in ProgressionConfig; anything missing falls back to the compiled default.
_xp_comment: Reaching level 2 costs `base`; every level after costs `growth` times the one before. At 100 x1.5 the steps run 100/150/225/338/506 and level 30 costs ~8.5M for ~25.6M cumulative.

tunables._damage_comment: Percentage damage reducers sum in percentage space and apply once, so -10% and -10% is -20%. The cap stops enough stacked sources from reaching immunity.
tunables._form_comment: Cooldowns are absolute expiry instants and keep ticking in both forms, so no swap can shorten one. This exists only to stop frame-by-frame flicker; set it to 0 to make swapping free.
tunables._vitals_comment: Vitality drives health. The three resource stats map one-to-one onto the three roles: Focus feeds Mana for healers, Stamina Capacity feeds Stamina for DPS, Endurance feeds Rage for tanks.
tunables._ferality_comment: The single knob controlling the Human/Animal power gap. Animal Form ability output is multiplied by 1 + ferality * this. Human Form is weaker on two axes at once — reduced output and no race passive — so raise this if the gap feels punitive rather than 'not by a lot'.
tunables._rage_comment: Rage inverts the usual pool: it builds through combat instead of draining, and decays out of it.
